summary.intent: Orchestrate the GSD plan:pre pipeline for phase 73 (shared-write-navigation-correctness-web) — spawn researcher, pattern-mapper, planner, and plan-checker agents faithfully per the configured hook contracts, then produce phase planning docs.
summary.outcome: Set up pipeline task tracking for the full sequence and synchronously spawned gsd-phase-researcher, which produced 73-RESEARCH.md covering the 7 SC target seams; downstream steps (VALIDATION.md, PATTERNS.md, planner, plan-checker) were queued but not yet executed.

repo: GSD plan:pre pipeline for this project has 6 active hooks: intel, research, pattern-mapper, schema-gate→planner, tdd→planner, drift-gate.
schema-gate hook only fires for TypeORM entity/migration file changes; phase 73 (SDK/web hooks only) doesn't trigger it even though SC4 surfaces an already-emitted tombstone at the SDK layer.
TDD mode being active means the planner automatically receives a tdd contribution alongside CONTEXT/ROADMAP/RESEARCH/PATTERNS.
Agent-skill contracts for researcher/planner/checker were empty in this repo — those agents fall back to their baked-in contracts.
Phase branch for this work is feat/shared-write-navigation-correctness-web; plan-checker step includes reconciling any stray branch back to it.
workflow: GSD orchestrator rule: spawn the researcher agent synchronously (sonnet) and wait for it rather than firing and forgetting.
plan-checker (sonnet) is expected to iterate up to 3x until it returns PASS.

PATTERNS.md must be committed explicitly by the orchestrator after gsd-pattern-mapper runs, since plan-phase does not commit it automatically (matches existing memory: [[feedback-gsd-...]] pattern of GSD steps needing manual follow-through).

open_items: If 73-RESEARCH.md has a Validation Architecture section, write 73-VALIDATION.md from template and commit it.
Spawn gsd-pattern-mapper to produce PATTERNS.md and commit it explicitly.
Regenerate intel API-SURFACE.md, then spawn gsd-planner (opus) with CONTEXT/ROADMAP/RESEARCH/PATTERNS + tdd contribution; SC4 is locked to wire-end-to-end.
Spawn gsd-plan-checker (sonnet), iterating up to 3x until PASS; confirm resulting plans land on feat/shared-write-navigation-correctness-web.
